brief: Inspect and prioritize the Underhill Bluff 138/13kV transformer ahead of the heat event, noting that its advanced age reduces its margin against mechanical failure under thermal stress [MG-023]. If this ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Since the unit is ONAN cooled rather than forced-cooled, apply the ambient and sustained event de-ratings detailed in MG-021 where applicable [MG-021].
